text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: U-u-u-um, Doto? Do you have a moment? I'm really sorry to bother you…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I want to talk to you about your recent condition and… race-readiness…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That day, Agnes Digital summoned her courage and spoke with Meisho Doto.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day has finally come when we get to learn of the results of her intervention.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! I can't! My oshi! I can't even look at her!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's Doto's first graded race! I swear if my meddling causes her to screw up, I'll just… I just hope she's able to finish safely!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto's first attempt at a graded race is the G2 Nikkei Shinshun Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not much is expected from her though, considering she's eighth on the list of favorites.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clang!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And here comes Meisho Doto! Meisho Doto brings it in for a shocking second-place finish!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: What a knockout comeback after her slump at the end of the year! What could have been the catalyst?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh… She got second?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Trainer! She did it! My oshi did it! My unsolicited advice didn't lead her astray!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital still believes that she crossed the line. But then…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Digital! Digital! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Your talk on race-readiness helped me power through my disaster period.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I kept telling myself everything would be okay, and it's finally happened. I'm so grateful you talked to me…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: D-Doto?! Wait. Hold on, please… My heart… I can't take any more…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: It's aaall thanks to you, Digital. Sniffle… Thank you so, so much!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Bwaaaagh…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's like a whole new world has opened… My body feels… full…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital experiences a moment of nirvana thanks to Meisho Doto's heartfelt gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyah! I'm so sorry. I got so overwhelmed hearing you say that. Everything went blank!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: So you don't hate me? Even though I lectured you like I was some kind of know-it-all?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I really appreciate what you did. I need assistance and support in order to get better.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Really? You? How could that be true for a practically real-life angel?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A real-life a-angel? Oh my goodness… I'm nothing like that, honest!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I… can't do anything on my own. That's why I need to learn and experience a lot of different things… if I want to bridge the gap.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: So… I really didn't bother you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Also… when you said you want to "bridge the gap," did you mean, like…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The gap between you and Opera O? Is it because growing apart hurts too much???

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Especially when she's all you ever dreamed of?!? And you'd do anything to be by her side?!!?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: That's right. ♪ After all…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I respect Opera O so much. I want to be as confident as her one day!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto speaks without hesitation, and a light I've never seen before flashes in Agnes Digital's eyes as she takes it in.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. Or should I say, my comrade in simping? I've got a question for you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: What does it mean to be sublime?
choice_data_list: That's kind of a broad question…
That's kind of a broad question…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yeah… You're right. But… I feel like I don't understand it anymore.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I thought keeping my distance from the sacred Umas was the de facto proper behavior. But now I've gone and engaged with Doto directly, and what happened?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: She smiled at me… She spoke to me about her object of admiration… and her pure desire to pursue it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I got a shining glimpse of something I'd never seen before.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: What was that? It was different from the usual allure.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: There was no hint of the squealing or giggling I expected… It was a totally unadulterated brilliance…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: One so strong, it could purify the entire world… What is that unknown radiance?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital mulls over this question for a moment…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Gyaah! I've got no clue! Literally no clue! And all this thinking is giving me a headache!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I still don't fully understand the charm of Umamusume… But from this day forward, I'm gonna figure out how to figure it out…
choice_data_list: How about trying to find it through racing?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Racing, huh? Yeah… if I don't run alongside them myself, I might never discover it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: All right, then. I'll try to take another look at their purity in the Hyacinth Stakes!
